notes: The age groups appear to be 10-year bands from <10 to ≥80 years, probably 9 groups. The text does not list every band, so n_groups is null. Telemedicine use is health care use, so no condition is recorded. Survey weighting is not stated, so it is not recorded.
view_issues: The 'similar' and 'increased with age' claims cite no test or CI-overlap rule. Only CI error bars are shown, so the basis of these claims is unstated.
